method: Python Decimal dimensional calculation, no marketplace experiment or profitability model validation

input_definition: rentable GPUs is the GPU capacity offered for rental throughout the modeled period, before applying utilization. If capacity changes, use separate time periods or a time-weighted capacity.
gross_components: Compute, instance storage, bandwidth and separately rented volumes are distinct modeled revenue categories; do not count volume storage again under instance storage. The sum is gross, not profit or a guaranteed bill.
